scenes.text: Compare living things and ways people depend on them
Germination: the early growth of a seed into a seedling. Habitat: the natural place where an organism lives.
Food chain: the path of food energy from one living thing to another. Biodiversity: the variety of living things in an area. Conservation: protecting plants, animals and habitats.
Observe a plant for a week and draw a simple food chain without harming animals.
